# Menu

Menu markup with horizontal, vertical and recursively nested navigation examples. Every item that has a submenu gets a toggle button right after its own link, so the item needs a direct link of its own: one without is skipped, with a warning in the console. The first level of a horizontal menu floats its submenu as a dropdown, and every other submenu opens in place. A menu without a ul list is skipped as well.

## PGS

- `menu`: identifies the menu element used by Menu.

## PGS generated by JavaScript

- `_menu-submenuButton`: the toggle inserted after the link of every item that has a submenu; it looks and sits the same whichever behavior it drives.
- `_menu-accordion`: marks an item whose submenu opens in place rather than floating, which is every item of a vertical menu and every level below the first of a horizontal one.

## PGS Options (component brackets)

- `menuHorizontal`: identifies the horizontal element used by Menu.
- `menuVertical`: identifies the vertical element used by Menu.
- `menuIconOnlyCurrent`: displays link icons only when the link has an active aria-current value.
- `menuShort`: compacts adjacent menu links by overlapping their horizontal spacing.

## PGS States

- `open`: written on an item whose submenu is open: the module toggles it from the item's own toggle button, and for a floating submenu the dropdown writes it.

## JavaScript API

- `pgs.menu.init(root)`: initializes menus within the specified Document or Element, including the element itself when it is a menu, and the dropdowns of its floating submenus.
- `pgs.menu.api(element)`: returns the instance associated with the specified initialized element.
- `instance.refresh()`: destroys the instance and initializes this menu again from its current markup, picking up the items added since, then returns the new instance. The toggles already generated are reused, never added twice.
- `instance.destroy()`: releases the listeners of this menu and destroys the dropdown instances it created. The generated toggles and tokens stay in the markup.

## Related elements

### PGS

- `flex`: provides the flex layout; direction and spacing are flags in its bracket.
- `button`: styles a menu link, now that the menu no longer does it itself.
- `icon`: draws the glyphs this example shows; see Icon for the whole set.

### PGS Options (component brackets)

- `btnCurrent`: gives the link the current look while it carries aria-current="page"; belongs to the button component.
- `btnTransparent`: the appearance a navigation link takes, whatever the menu's direction; see Button for the whole set of variants.
- `row`: lays the top-level list out as a row, so a long menu can be measured against the space it has.
- `wrap`: lets that row break onto a second line instead of overflowing.
- `icon-circle`: a plain disc, standing in for a section icon.
- `icon-circleInfo`: the information mark.
- `icon-sliders`: the sliders glyph, standing in for a section icon.

### Other

- `dropdown`: uses the related dropdown component or utility in this example.
- `dropdown-button`: uses the related dropdown-button component or utility in this example.
- `dropdown-content`: uses the related dropdown-content component or utility in this example.
- `hoverNot`: disables hover behavior on menu buttons generated at runtime.
- `dropdownPosition`: set by Menu at runtime on the li it turns into a dropdown, to place the first-level floating submenu.

## CSS Variables

- `--menu-gap-column`
- `--menu-gap-row`

## Output

Horizontal and vertical menu examples, including recursively nested submenus.
## Examples

### Horizontal menu

Top-level navigation arranged horizontally: the submenus of the first level float as dropdowns, and a submenu nested inside one of them opens in place.

```html
<nav pgs="menu['menuHorizontal']" aria-label="Horizontal menu">
    <ul pgs="flex['row' 'wrap']">
        <li>
            <a pgs="button['btnTransparent' 'btnCurrent']" href="/" aria-current="page">
                <i pgs="icon['icon-circle']" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>Home</span>
            </a>
        </li>
        <li>
            <a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services">
                <i pgs="icon['icon-sliders']" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>Services</span>
            </a>
            <ul>
                <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/two">Second service</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li>
            <a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/about">
                <i pgs="icon['icon-circleInfo']" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>about</span>
            </a>
            <ul>
                <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                <li>
                    <a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/two">Second service</a>
                    <ul>
                        <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                        <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/two">Second service</a></li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>
</nav>
```

### Vertical menu

Vertical navigation with recursively nested submenus, all of them opening in place.

```html
<nav pgs="menu['menuVertical']" aria-label="Vertical menu">
    <ul>
        <li>
            <a pgs="button['btnTransparent' 'btnCurrent']" href="/" aria-current="page">
                <i pgs="icon['icon-circle']" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>Home</span>
            </a>
        </li>
        <li>
            <a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services">
                <i pgs="icon['icon-sliders']" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>Services</span>
            </a>
            <ul>
                <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/two">Second service</a></li>
            </ul>
        </li>
        <li>
            <a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/about">
                <i pgs="icon['icon-circleInfo']" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                <span>about</span>
            </a>
            <ul>
                <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                <li>
                    <a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/two">Second service</a>
                    <ul>
                        <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/one">First service</a></li>
                        <li><a pgs="button['btnTransparent']" href="/services/two">Second service</a></li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>
</nav>
```
